g.text: SuperMAS Email Assistant — Agent Organization and Context Boundaries
Provider is shared infrastructure, not a shared knowledge pool.
Each request carries agentId + permitted source IDs.
Execution box describes selected-agent behavior, not an extra agent.
Selected agent assembles bounded context and invokes LocalLlmClient.
generated draft returned by selected agent
Purple: routing and organization. Green: local context / memory / inference.
Orange: human review and mail boundary.
Roles and source sets are illustrative; agents may be added through configuration.
Optional critic, RAG and additional agents are outside the proposed baseline.
